headline: Danantara Injects Rp162 T Investment, Tackles Waste Project and Hajj Hotel
summary: BPI Danantara has disbursed Rp162 trillion for investment, according to the input. Reported projects include waste management and a Hajj hotel.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's state investment holding company, and its capital deployment shapes infrastructure and state-linked business activity.
original_headline: Danantara Kucurkan Investasi Rp162 T, Garap Proyek Sampah-Hotel Haji
